classes.C: Mission configuration recorded in case.json (limits, gains, vehicle constants). Added to the requested classes because configuration is neither truth nor estimate.
classes.D-host: Derived by the recording host and stored in the run (verifier verdicts, host metrics, the interpolated contact sample).
classes.D-view: Derived by this view's extractor from recorded values. Arithmetic is named in the derivation registry; nothing is simulated.
classes.E: Estimate, recorded: what the controller's estimator reported, as stored in the trace.
classes.O: Observation, recorded: what a sensor delivered to the controller, as stored in the trace.
classes.S: From source code, not recorded in the run: read in the Rust sources at the stated lines.
classes.T: Truth, recorded: the simulator's true state, as stored in the trace.

altimeter_minus_truth_nozzle.formula: altimeter - truth nozzle-plane z (base_position_m[2]). Both refer to the nozzle plane.

altimeter_residual.formula: altimeter - estimated nozzle altitude, from the recorded post-update estimate at the sample. Approximate: the controller's own residual (S_rejection_rule) is evaluated every 0.02 s on a pre-update estimate with an unrecorded s_cm; the recorded estimate already includes the update of that cycle.

believed_nozzle_xy.formula: estimated centre-of-mass x,y + horizontal part of rotate(IMU attitude, (-s_cm,0,0)). The nozzle-plane point guidance steers (S_nozzle_from_cm). Uses the s_cm proxy.

believed_pad_distance.formula: hypot(believed nozzle x - pad x, believed nozzle y - pad y), pad from case.json.

body_axis_z_from_imu.formula: z component of the body x axis rotated by the IMU attitude quaternion [w,x,y,z]: 2*(x*z - w*y).

control_period.formula: control_period_steps * dt_s: how often the controller runs.

est_minus_truth.formula: estimate_k - truth_k, both centre of mass, same axis k.

est_nozzle_altitude.formula: estimated centre-of-mass z - s_cm * body_axis_z (nozzle-plane altitude believed by the estimator). Uses the s_cm proxy.

guidance_rule_from_flag.formula: 'min(estimator, altimeter)' while the recorded altimeter_rejected flag is true, 'estimator' otherwise (S_guidance_min, guarded policy). Says which rule was active, not which value won.

lower_altitude_source.formula: While the rule is active: 'altimeter' if altimeter < estimated nozzle altitude, else 'estimator'. The altitude the min() of S_guidance_min would pick. Approximate (same limits as altimeter_residual); null while the rule is inactive.

max_abs_before_fault.formula: Largest absolute value of the named series over the samples before the fault start.

max_offset_check.formula: Largest |(truth cm z - truth nozzle z) - s_cm*n_z| over the samples, using the truth attitude. A check of the proxy geometry, not a measure of the controller's s_cm.

obs_minus_truth.formula: gnss_k - truth_k: GNSS position is a centre-of-mass observation, same axis k.

s_cm_proxy.formula: s_cm = (dry_mass*dry_cm_station + propellant*propellant_cm_station) / (dry_mass + propellant), with the recorded TRUTH propellant as a proxy for the controller's unrecorded nominal propellant.

s_cm_station_bound.formula: s_cm with full propellant and with empty tanks, from case.json vehicle constants.

touchdown_gap.formula: hypot(true nozzle x - believed nozzle x, true nozzle y - believed nozzle y) at the touchdown sample. The believed point is the last estimate before contact, approximate.

touchdown_sample_value.formula: Value of the named series at the touchdown sample (the last sample), unchanged.

events.label: Touchdown: the nozzle plane reaches the ground

case.gnss_sigma_m.label: GNSS position noise (1 sigma, per axis)

check.offset_geometry_m.label: Largest centre-of-mass to nozzle offset mismatch (geometry check)

pre.max_abs_err_x.label: Largest |estimate - truth| in x before the fault

pre.max_abs_residual.label: Largest |altimeter residual| before the fault (approx.)
pre.max_abs_residual.note: Pre-fault agreement supports the s_cm proxy: a large error in s_cm would show here.

run.model_validity.label: Model validity statement
run.model_validity.v: Idealised demonstrator; not flight software and not validated against flight data. No contact dynamics: touchdown is the instant the nozzle exit plane reaches the ground. Requirements, dispersions and sensor noise are assumed values, not those of a real vehicle.

run.outcome_explanation.label: Outcome explanation
run.outcome_explanation.v: The stage reached the ground at 22.96 s but did not meet the mission requirements: Distance from pad centre 12.452456 m (required <= 10 m).

run.reject_first_t_s.label: Altimeter first rejected (controller flag)
run.reject_first_t_s.note: Controller-reported; not used for any verdict.

run.touchdown_t_s.label: Touchdown time
run.touchdown_t_s.note: Interpolated by the host between two steps (S_touchdown_sample).

run.verdict_note.label: Host note on sampling and verdicts
run.verdict_note.v: The trace is sampled every 0.1 s (10 steps of 0.01 s); the touchdown sample is interpolated to the instant of contact. Verdicts are computed on every step, not on the samples.

td.altimeter.label: Altimeter reading, last control cycle before contact

td.believed_nozzle_x.label: Believed nozzle-plane x, last estimate before contact (approx.)

td.believed_nozzle_y.label: Believed nozzle-plane y, last estimate before contact (approx.)

td.believed_pad_distance.label: Believed distance from pad centre, last estimate before contact (approx.)

td.err_est_x.label: Estimate - truth in x, last estimate before contact

td.err_z_host.label: Estimate - truth in z, last estimate before contact (host metric)

td.est_cm_x.label: Last estimated centre-of-mass x before contact

td.est_cm_y.label: Last estimated centre-of-mass y before contact

td.est_nozzle_alt.label: Estimated nozzle altitude, last estimate before contact (approx.)

td.gap_m.label: Distance between true nozzle point and believed nozzle point at touchdown (approx.)

td.true_nozzle_x.label: True nozzle-plane x at touchdown
td.true_nozzle_x.note: Truth of the touchdown sample is the host's interpolated contact state.

alt_residual.label: Altimeter - estimated nozzle altitude (approx.)
alt_residual.note: Computed by this view, approximate: the controller's residual uses unrecorded internal terms.

believed_nozzle_x.label: Believed nozzle-plane position x (approx.)
believed_nozzle_x.note: At the touchdown sample this is the last recorded estimate before contact, not the belief at the touchdown instant (S_last_cycle_in_sample).

believed_nozzle_y.label: Believed nozzle-plane position y (approx.)
believed_nozzle_y.note: At the touchdown sample this is the last recorded estimate before contact, not the belief at the touchdown instant (S_last_cycle_in_sample).

believed_pad_distance.label: Believed distance of nozzle plane from pad centre (approx.)

gnss_x.label: GNSS position x (observation)
gnss_x.note: Null where GNSS delivered nothing in that control cycle.

gnss_y.label: GNSS position y (observation)
gnss_y.note: Null where GNSS delivered nothing in that control cycle.

gnss_z.label: GNSS position z (observation)
gnss_z.note: Null where GNSS delivered nothing in that control cycle.

imu_nz.label: Body-axis z component from IMU attitude

lower_source.label: Lower of the two altitudes while the rule is active (approx.)

pad_distance_host.label: True distance of nozzle plane from pad centre (host metric)

s_cm.label: Centre-of-mass station s_cm (proxy)
s_cm.note: Uses recorded TRUTH propellant as a proxy for the controller's nominal propellant.

S_altimeter_nozzle.claim: The altimeter measures the height of the nozzle plane (base z), not of the centre of mass.

S_estimator_fixed_gain.claim: The estimator is a fixed-gain blend of IMU propagation, GNSS and a gated altimeter. It holds a position and a velocity and no covariance, so it has no uncertainty to report. The estimated position is the centre of mass.

S_gnss_bias.claim: The gnss_bias fault adds its magnitude to the GNSS position x and z (not y). GNSS position observes the centre of mass. GNSS velocity carries no bias.

S_guidance_min.claim: With the guarded policy, while the altimeter is rejected, guidance (only guidance; the estimator state is untouched) reads the lower of the estimated nozzle-plane altitude and the altimeter. A cycle without an altimeter sample uses the estimator's altitude. Which of the two was lower in a given cycle is not recorded.

anchors: pub fn interpolate(a: &State, b: &State, u: f64) -> State {
S_interpolate.claim: Interpolation of the contact is linear in every component of the true state.

S_invariant_limits.claim: S1 is a lower bound (cosine of tilt at least the limit); S2 to S5 are upper bounds. S2 is evaluated at the contact only. Invariants keep a worst value and a first failure (null when none), not a time series.

anchors: let current = cycle.as_ref().ok_or("no control cycle at step 0")?;
S_last_cycle_in_sample.claim: The estimate and the observation stored in a sample are those of the latest control cycle, which can be a step or more older than the sample's own step.

S_nozzle_from_cm.claim: Guidance converts the estimated centre-of-mass position to the nozzle plane with the attitude and s_cm, and steers that nozzle-plane point (horizontal offset to the pad, altitude).

S_outcome_rule.claim: Outcome rule: no contact gives no_contact; contact with every requirement passing and S5 holding gives landed; every other contact gives hard_landing. The label therefore says that some requirement or S5 failed, not that the impact was hard.

S_rejection_rule.claim: The altimeter residual is the altimeter minus the estimated nozzle-plane altitude (estimated centre-of-mass z minus s_cm times the body-axis z component). The altimeter is rejected after the configured number of consecutive control cycles with a residual above the threshold. s_cm comes from the controller's own nominal propellant, which is not recorded.

anchors: let t_touch = ((step - 1) as f64 + u) * dt;
S_touchdown_sample.claim: The touchdown sample is off the sampling grid. Its truth is the contact state interpolated by the host between two steps; its estimate and observation are those of the latest control cycle, not interpolated.
